datasets.name: ODSCourt
datasets.sql:
SELECT p.id,p.courtid,p.boorowerid,p.numberofcredit,val_name,b.name,
       rest,duerest,interestrest,p.creditlineamount,h.penaltyrest, 
       p.dateofconclusion,p.duedatefirstcontract,p.qovid,(select name from ct_qrup where id=p.courtid) CORT_STATUS,
       case when p.placestatus=0 then (select name from ct_executive_body where id=p.placeid) else (select name from ct_judicial_body where id=p.placeid) end as placename,
       cr.description crtype,b.phonenumber,p.annualyinterestrate,p.annualyoverduerate,p.annualypenaltyrate,
       dueinterestrest,p.purposeofcredit,cm_utils.Get_MainPlanPayment(p.id) odenilmeli,
       cm_utils.Get_MainPlanPayment(p.id)+ duerest + interestrest + dueinterestrest+h.penaltyrest fullrest,
       dueday,q.name qovluq,f.name filial,m.name mehsul,a.name meqed,e.name expert,r.description ehtiyyat,py.maxpaydate,
       case when dueday =1 then 0
        when py.maxpaydate=sbop.GET_DATE then 1  end as status,        
  b.pincode,b.boorowerid pasnum,b.address,i.birthday dogum_tarixi,i.birthplace dogum_yeri,i.work_place,i.work_post
FROM cm_active_credits p,
     cm_credittypes cr,
     cm_curr_state h,
     cm_boorowerinfo b,
     cm_qovluq q,
     filial_t f,
     avalute_t v,
     cm_mehsul m ,
     cm_aim_cred a,
     cm_expert e,
     cm_reserve_types r,custinfo i,
     (select creditid ,max(paydate) maxpaydate from cm_payments group by creditid) py
     
WHERE     p.id = h.creditid
      AND p.id = b.creditid
      AND p.id = py.creditid(+)
      AND p.qovid = q.id
      AND p.mehsulid=m.id
      AND h.reserveid=r.id
      AND p.aim_id=a.id
      AND p.expertid=e.id
      AND h.rest + h.duerest + h.interestrest + h.interestrest > 0
      AND h.dueday>0
      AND p.branchid = f.id
      AND p.currency = v.valute
      AND p.credittype = cr.id
      AND uid in( select userid from ct_admin_in  where qrupid=p.courtid ) and p.boorowerid=i.idcust
  










  order by :title

datasets.name: ScheduleCourt
datasets.sql:
SELECT rownum sira, id, creditid, paymentdate, rest,
    principal, 
    interest,
    principal+interest as sm
  FROM cm_payment_schedule
 WHERE CreditID=:CrdID
order  by paymentdate

datasets.name: PaymentsCourt
datasets.sql:
SELECT rownum sira,  id ,
        creditid ,
        paydate , 
        payedamt , 
        payedintamt,
        payeddueamt,
       payeddueintamt, 
       payedpenaltyamt,
    payedamt + 
        payedintamt+
        payeddueamt+
       payeddueintamt+ 
       payedpenaltyamt as sm

  FROM cm_payments 
WHERE (CreditID=:CrdID)
order by paydate desc

datasets.name: PaymentReport
datasets.sql:
select rownum sıra, p.id, p.numberofcredit,b.name custname, s.paydate,s.payedamt,s.payedintamt,s.payeddueamt,s.payeddueintamt,
s.payedpenaltyamt,s.dueday ,q.name,(select name from ct_qrup where id=p.courtid) CORT_STATUS  from
cm_active_credits p,
cm_payments s,
cm_qovluq q,
cm_boorowerinfo b,
ct_qrup cq
where 
p.id=s.creditid 
And p.id=b.creditid
And s.qovid=q.id 
And cq.id=p.courtid
And  uid in( select userid from ct_admin_in  where qrupid=p.courtid )
And s.paydate between :bdat and :edat

order by p.id
